claim_limits: Task admission only: no record is promoted to a development_* or confirmatory Track-B split here.
TS identity is source-declared for the reaction ID; the IRC asset that could verify it is not part of this audit.
Parent groups are project-derived, not an official Reaction-QM family annotation.
Energies are species-level EHG triples; no forces exist in the main HDF5.

The Zenodo record metadata declares CC-BY-4.0 (checked via the Zenodo API on 2026-10-06); attribution (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18551029 and the dataset paper) is required and per-record third-party provenance was not independently verified. This funnel records identities and hashes only; no raw bytes are redistributed.

aromatic_representation_pending.next_action: aromatic bond orders need an explicit Kekule/representation rule before a bond-electron label is trusted (#71)

endpoint_connectivity_mismatch.next_action: an endpoint species is not the molecule written on the TS side (different connectivity); the event label cannot be tied to the endpoint geometry

endpoint_mapping_not_certified.next_action: endpoint local->global correspondence is ambiguous or absent; needs an independent mapping table or geometry-independent evidence

endpoint_representation_mismatch.next_action: an endpoint species and the TS-side component share connectivity but disagree on bond orders/charges; the bond-order event label is representation dependent, so it is withheld until a resonance rule is agreed

forces_absent_in_source.next_action: the main HDF5 has no forces; they exist only in the separate IRC asset (not downloaded)

non_integral_bond_edit.next_action: a bond order changes by a non-integer amount; no integer event label can be derived

out_of_scope_element.next_action: outside the declared CHNOS pool (configs/task.yaml); deferred_out_of_scope, not a chemistry label

species_inventory_mismatch.next_action: endpoint species do not add up to the TS atom inventory; in the examples inspected an identical molecule appears to be listed only once, which would need an explicit, verified duplicate-species rule

funnel.semantics: reaction records in the pinned HDF5
TS and endpoint species present, SMILES parse, contiguous unique map ids, coordinate shapes valid
CHNOS only, singlet, parity-consistent, charge conserved
TS and endpoint coordinate rows follow map order; both sides describe the same mapped atoms; species add up to the TS inventory

official_split_crosscheck.note: Official partition is by reaction ID only; groups spanning it indicate that ID-level splits can leak a parent system.
